documents.title: Customer Data Handling Policy
documents.content:
Section 4.2 · Privileged data access
Roles handling customer PII must complete an access review every 90 days. Reviews require manager approval and an immutable audit record.

Section 6.1 · Incident notification
Suspected customer-data exposure must be reported to Security and Legal within 30 minutes.

Section 8.4 · Third-party exports
Exports require manager and Data Protection approval with a retained audit record.

documents.title: API Authentication Standard
documents.content:
Section 3.1 · Service authentication
Production services must use short-lived workload identities. Static API keys are prohibited in application repositories and must be rotated through the approved secrets manager.

Section 5.2 · Privileged changes
Authentication changes require peer review, passing security checks and an auditable deployment approval.

chunks.content: Production services must use short-lived workload identities. Static API keys are prohibited in application repositories and must be rotated through the approved secrets manager.
Authentication changes require peer review, passing security checks and an auditable deployment approval.

documents.title: Incident Response SOP
documents.content:
Section 2.1 · Engineering incident response
The on-call developer must acknowledge a production security incident within 10 minutes, notify the incident commander and preserve logs before remediation.

Section 4.3 · Recovery verification
Recovery requires service health checks, an incident timeline and owner approval before closure.

chunks.content: The on-call developer must acknowledge a production security incident within 10 minutes, notify the incident commander and preserve logs before remediation.

documents.title: Platform Architecture & Developer Setup
documents.content:
Section 1 · System map
The product is a tenant-aware knowledge and readiness platform. The web application calls authenticated APIs that resolve organization, division and role before accessing stored knowledge.

Section 2 · Local development
Install dependencies, configure environment variables, start the web server and run the verification suite before opening a pull request. Never commit credentials.

Section 3 · Delivery standard
Every production change requires tests, peer review, security checks, observability and a rollback plan.

documents.title: Customer Support Trusted Answer Playbook
documents.content:
Section 1 · Trusted answers
Support agents must answer from an approved, current source and include the relevant policy section when the request involves customer data.

Section 2 · Escalation
Escalate suspected privacy, security or contractual issues to the named owner. Do not guess when evidence is insufficient.

documents.title: Operations Change Readiness SOP
documents.content:
Section 1 · Daily controls
Operations owners review exceptions, confirm handoffs and record material decisions in the audit trail.

Section 2 · Change readiness
Material SOP changes require owner approval, targeted learning and verification before the effective date.

chunks.content: Operations owners review exceptions, confirm handoffs and record material decisions in the audit trail.
Material SOP changes require owner approval, targeted learning and verification before the effective date.

documents.title: Policy Lifecycle & Evidence Standard
documents.content:
Section 1 · Policy lifecycle
Legal owners draft, review, approve and publish controlled policies with effective dates and version history.

Section 2 · Evidence
Each material interpretation must retain its source, approver and affected audience for audit readiness.
